name: CPA Manager Plus
description: Self-hosted management panel and observability dashboard for CLIProxyAPI: request history, usage and cost analytics, quota tracking, and account health.

notes.text: Requires an existing CLIProxyAPI instance. Connect it in the panel's first-time setup using the admin key from /etc/cpa-manager-plus/cpamp-admin-key inside the container.
Recommended CLIProxyAPI version v7.3.4 or newer; request monitoring needs v6.10.8 or newer.
